sections.content: Use *porque*, *debido* a, por *eso*, por lo tanto and *como* *consecuencia* to explain why prices or costs change and what follows.

items.spanish: Los precios suben porque hay mucha demanda.
items.english: Prices rise because there is high demand.

items.spanish: El producto es caro debido a la escasez.
items.english: The product is expensive due to the shortage.

items.spanish: Hay poca oferta; por eso, el precio aumenta.
items.english: There is little supply; therefore, the price increases.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia, algunas familias gastan menos.
items.english: As a consequence, some families spend less.

sections.content: Separate the cause from the consequence so the relationship is clear.
